stage0012_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
Firebug Trooper
「What are you doing!?
　Get out of here, now!」

stage0012_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Tch!
　So those guys were terrorists!」

stage0012_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$竜馬$$
「$$甲児$$!
　We'll get the rugby team out!
　You lot evacuate too!」

stage0012_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Geez!
　Why does he vanish at the worst times!」

stage0012_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
Firebug Trooper
「That voice...that force of will...」

stage0012_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
Firebug Trooper
「That kid could become the second 《$$姫$$》!」

stage0012_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$n!
　Call out $$ジェニオン$$!」

stage0012_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$スズネ$$
「What's wrong!?
　Are you feeling sick!?」

stage0012_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$n
「Sorry, teacher...
　Right after using $$ブーストアップ$$,
　I can't seem to call out $$ジェニオン$$.」

stage0012_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$アルト$$
「This is bad!
　At this rate...!」

stage0012_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$かなめ$$
「$$ボン太くん#robot$$!?
　And he's got a gun!」

stage0012_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Wh-what...!?
　$$ボン太くん#robot$$'s fighting the terrorists!?」

stage0012_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ボス$$
「Even for a bear, that's pushing it!」

stage0012_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ヌケ$$
「Look closer, $$ボス$$!
　That's a mouse!」

stage0012_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ムチャ$$
「What are you talking about!
　That's a koala!」

stage0012_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「This is no time for that!」

stage0012_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$アルト$$
「I-I don't really get it, but,
　if that Bonta thing says it'll fight,
　let's leave this to it!」

stage0012_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$クラン$$
「Don't get it wrong, $$アルト$$!
　That's $$ボン太くん#robot$$!
　Say 'kun', you forehead dummy!」

stage0012_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$スズネ$$
「The Quarter will be here soon!
　Let's evacuate too!」

stage0012_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$かなめ$$
（Don't tell me, that $$ボン太くん#robot$$ is...）

stage0012_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
Firebug Trooper
「I don't get it,
　but it's ready to throw down with us.」

stage0012_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
Firebug Trooper
「So that's the answer it settled on...!
　Then we'll take it on!」

stage0012_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Kept you waiting, huh!
　This time I'll take you on with my machine!」

stage0012_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$竜馬$$
「So what are you supposed to be?
　A bear? A mouse?」

stage0012_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Fine, whatever!
　At least I know you're not an enemy!」

stage0012_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Here I come, you terrorists!
　You'll be the finale of my training journey!」

stage0012_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
Firebug Trooper
「Damn it...!
　At this rate, we'll let them get cocky!」

stage0012_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
Firebug Trooper
「That does it, deploy the whole unit!」

stage0012_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$竜馬$$
「So they're throwing numbers at us.」

stage0012_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Yeah, looks like our reinforcements are here too.」

stage0012_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$竜馬$$
「You think I'd lose to guys like that?」

stage0012_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$n
「So that man from before
　is piloting that black Getter Robo.」

stage0012_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$スズネ$$
「But I heard Getter Robo needs three pilots...」

stage0012_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$甲児$$
「Now that you mention it, $$竜馬$$...
　where are $$隼人$$, $$弁慶$$, and $$號$$?」

stage0012_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$竜馬$$
「I'm in the middle of a training journey.
　What happens to the others isn't my concern.」

stage0012_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$竜馬$$
「I know, I know!
　Let's finish these guys off quick!」

stage0012_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Let's go, Fumo-suke!
　We'll crush them!」

stage0012_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$竜馬$$...can you understand that animal?」

stage0012_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$葵$$
「Not that I'm one to talk, but,
　call it wild instinct?」

stage0012_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$オットー$$
「Anyway!
　Beat them down and Tokyo gets a little quieter!
　Signal attack orders to all units!」

stage0012_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Ensign $$ミヒロ$$, where's your readback!?」

stage0012_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「S-sorry!
　I got distracted staring at $$ボン太くん#robot$$!」

stage0012_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$レイアム$$
「...Seems the Quarter's bridge is the same...」

stage0012_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「This should take care of the terrorists
　who had their sights on Tokyo.」

stage0012_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ミーナ#120$$
「$$モニカ$$, did you get photos of $$ボン太くん#robot$$!?」

stage0012_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ラム$$
「Print them out for us later, okay!」

stage0012_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...Every now and then, this isn't so bad...」

stage0012_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
???
「Heh heh heh...$$兜甲児$$.
　Don't think this is over.」

stage0012_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ボン太くん#pilot$$
「Fumo! Fumofumo, fumomo, mofu!
　Fumoffu!」

stage0012_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$竜馬$$
「No matter how times or worlds change,
　annoying guys like you never change!」

stage0012_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$竜馬$$
「But I've got too much fight in me too!
　I'll take you on, no problem!」

stage0012_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Heh...you're really fired up!
　We could make a good team, you and me!」

stage0012_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$甲児$$
「You've got some nerve, ruining our training camp!」

stage0012_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$甲児$$
「In place of the rugby team,
　I'll finish you off myself!」

stage0012_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$アルト$$
「We don't have time to waste on you!」

stage0012_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$アルト$$
「Let's wrap this up quick,
　and get back to the camp!」

stage0012_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's go, $$鉄人$$!
　We'll beat them and protect Tokyo!」

stage0012_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I've gotta beat you fast and get back to school,
　or Ms. $$美重子$$ will scold me again!」

stage0012_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Here I come, villains!
　I'll take out all my make-up-class stress on you!」

stage0012_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Still, that odd animal costume...
　Modified as it may be, it's quite the fighter.」

stage0012_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「...Don't tell me, whoever's wearing that is...」

stage0012_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$葵$$
「Guess a new world doesn't get rid of guys like this...
　Kinda like cockroaches, huh?」

stage0012_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$葵$$
「Then let's do some pest control!
　Whoever's ready, bring it on!」

stage0012_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$キリコ$$
（That animal...
　Get fooled by looks and you'll pay for it...）

stage0012_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$キリコ$$
（That thing's basically a small AS now.）

stage0012_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Geez, that gloomy sergeant of ours
　sure pulls off the unimaginable!」

stage0012_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$スズネ$$
「...Ah...it flew...
　It bounced, it tumbled...」

stage0012_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I-I wasn't watching $$ボン太くん#robot$$ at all!」

stage0012_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$n
「Nah...just realized you're a woman too, teacher...」

stage0012_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Honestly! Quit teasing adults
　and focus on the battle!」

stage0012_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$カツ$$
「Raaargh, charge!
　Gung ho! Gung ho! Gung ho!」

stage0012_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$マオ$$
「Sorry, Lieutenant $$エマ$$.
　Guess he got a little carried away.」

stage0012_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$カツ$$
「You bastards!
　Show me your guts, all of you!!」
